field_label_policy: descriptive names derived from C# writes; group names follow frozen schema

fields.name: self_velocity_yaw_local_x
fields.notes: v_local=inverse(yaw)*Motor.WorldVelocity; fallback=(position-previousPosition)/dt if Motor is absent.

fields.name: self_velocity_yaw_local_y
fields.notes: v_local=inverse(yaw)*Motor.WorldVelocity; fallback=(position-previousPosition)/dt if Motor is absent.

fields.name: self_velocity_yaw_local_z
fields.notes: v_local=inverse(yaw)*Motor.WorldVelocity; fallback=(position-previousPosition)/dt if Motor is absent.

fields.name: self_euler_rate_pitch_x
fields.coordinate_frame: body Euler-angle derivative; not a rotated angular-velocity vector

fields.name: self_euler_rate_yaw_y
fields.coordinate_frame: body Euler-angle derivative; not a rotated angular-velocity vector

fields.name: self_euler_rate_roll_z
fields.coordinate_frame: body Euler-angle derivative; not a rotated angular-velocity vector

fields.name: grounded
fields.notes: Binary.

fields.name: crouched
fields.construction_and_normalization: 1 if Motor exists and Motor.IsCrouched else 0
fields.notes: IsCrouched checks controller height <0.75*standingHeight; it is not just the command bit.

fields.name: self_health_fraction
fields.construction_and_normalization: Health.GetHealthNormalized() = CurrentHealth/MaxHealth; 0 if component absent or MaxHealth<=0
fields.notes: No additional Clamp01 in this sensor write; range assumes normal bounded health state.

fields.name: self_current_ammo_fraction
fields.construction_and_normalization: clip[0, 1](Weapon.CurrentAmmo/Weapon.MaxAmmo); 0 if no weapon or MaxAmmo<=0
fields.notes: Frozen schema calls this magazine fraction. Restored PlayerWeapon accessors return equal CurrentAmmo and MaxAmmo (1/1 or debug999/999), yielding 1 with a weapon. This accessor observation is source evidence; it is not independent verification of every compiled weapon revision.

fields.name: reserve_ammo_placeholder
fields.notes: Manifest describes reserve fraction; actual sensor write is hard-coded zero.

fields.name: weapon_cooldown_fraction
fields.notes: Weapon cooldown, not MatchManager global round cooldown. Denominator is base FireCooldownSeconds, not necessarily the effective multiplier-adjusted cooldown.

fields.name: recent_damage_valid
fields.availability_and_sentinel: All four cue fields are 0 before a valid cue or after ResetMemory.
fields.notes: Cue is set from last incoming hit; horizontal shooter bearing jittered uniformly by ±12 degrees. Validity does not expire automatically; only age saturates. Stored world direction is re-expressed using current yaw, but does not track enemy movement or recompute a bearing from a remembered point.

fields.name: recent_damage_bearing_sin
fields.availability_and_sentinel: All four cue fields are 0 before a valid cue or after ResetMemory.

fields.name: recent_damage_bearing_cos
fields.availability_and_sentinel: All four cue fields are 0 before a valid cue or after ResetMemory.

fields.name: recent_damage_age
fields.availability_and_sentinel: All four cue fields are 0 before a valid cue or after ResetMemory.
fields.notes: Age=1 means at least5 s old; it does not invalidate the cue.

fields.name: previous_command_move_x
fields.notes: lateral: +right; previousAction is the Controller.GetCommand() cached at the preceding advancing sensor update, not a guaranteed completed gameplay action.

fields.name: previous_command_move_z
fields.notes: forward: +forward; previousAction is the Controller.GetCommand() cached at the preceding advancing sensor update, not a guaranteed completed gameplay action.

fields.name: previous_command_yaw
fields.notes: yaw: +right; previousAction is the Controller.GetCommand() cached at the preceding advancing sensor update, not a guaranteed completed gameplay action.

fields.name: previous_command_pitch
fields.notes: pitch: +up; previousAction is the Controller.GetCommand() cached at the preceding advancing sensor update, not a guaranteed completed gameplay action.

fields.name: previous_command_shoot
fields.notes: shoot; previousAction is the Controller.GetCommand() cached at the preceding advancing sensor update, not a guaranteed completed gameplay action.

fields.name: previous_command_reload
fields.notes: reload; previousAction is the Controller.GetCommand() cached at the preceding advancing sensor update, not a guaranteed completed gameplay action.

fields.name: previous_command_jump
fields.notes: jump; previousAction is the Controller.GetCommand() cached at the preceding advancing sensor update, not a guaranteed completed gameplay action.

fields.name: previous_command_crouch
fields.notes: crouch; previousAction is the Controller.GetCommand() cached at the preceding advancing sensor update, not a guaranteed completed gameplay action.

fields.name: step_displacement
fields.notes: 3D displacement since the previous advancing update, not a velocity or averaged path progress.

fields.name: short_stuck_fraction
fields.construction_and_normalization: mean of shortStuck, up to 25 samples
fields.notes: Each sample=1 if abs(currentCommand.MoveX)+abs(currentCommand.MoveZ)>0.2 AND 3D displacement<0.02 units; otherwise0. Window is nominally 0.5 s at 50 Hz; warmup divides by actual queue length, empty queue returns0.

fields.name: long_stuck_fraction
fields.construction_and_normalization: mean of longStuck, up to 100 samples
fields.notes: Each sample=1 if abs(currentCommand.MoveX)+abs(currentCommand.MoveZ)>0.2 AND 3D displacement<0.02 units; otherwise0. Window is nominally 2 s at 50 Hz; warmup divides by actual queue length, empty queue returns0.

fields.name: collision_fraction
fields.construction_and_normalization: mean of collisionHistory, up to 25 samples
fields.notes: Each sample=1 if Motor.LastCollisionFlags != None; includes Below/Above/Sides, not only wall/side collisions. Window is nominally 0.5 s at 50 Hz; warmup divides by actual queue length, empty queue returns0.

fields.name: time_since_progress
fields.notes: lastProgressTime refreshes whenever 3D displacement>=0.02 units, regardless of whether movement was requested.

notes: All indices are zero-based. Names are descriptive labels for the actual writes; the frozen manifest names groups rather than every scalar.

actor231 is exactly the environment vector. The manifest’s composite_actor_input_dim=363 equals 231+132 policy-owned tactical/recurrent state; it does not describe 363 Unity sensor fields. Current navigator code consumes 231 observations and passes GRU hidden state separately.

Positions/linear velocities/rays/memories use a yaw-only local frame: x right, y up, z forward. Angular-rate fields 3..5 are Euler-angle finite differences, not a rotated physical angular-velocity vector.

Angles for radial probes: 0 degrees forward, 90 right, 180 back, 270 left. Torso and free-space sector 0 start forward. Hunt sector 0 instead starts at -180 degrees; it is not the same indexing convention.

Ranges describe valid finite telemetry and ignore floating-point roundoff. All emitted values are dimensionless. u denotes a Unity length unit; frozen schema prose calls these metres, but an independent real-world unit calibration is not recorded.
dt=max(Time.fixedDeltaTime, 0.0001). Fixed timestep is 0.02 s. History lengths 25 and 100 therefore span nominally 0.5 and 2 s after warmup.
BuildObservation clears all 231 outputs first. Missing self/opponent/CharacterController returns an all-zero vector. The per-field miss/invalid defaults below describe normal component availability.

Frozen actor normalizer is analytic_bounded_identity: mean 0/std 1 for every field, no fitted whitening. Unity supplies scaling/clipping. The inspected current inference adapter passes actor231 directly to the navigator; it does not apply another statistical normalizer. The JSON records the frozen per-index safety envelope, which is often wider than a field’s actual binary/nonnegative range.

The source comment claiming hidden geometry is consulted only for LOS is incomplete: UpdateHuntCue also reads hidden geometry inside its permitted quantizer. Current exact visible-target features 193..201 are zero while hidden.

StaticRay ignores trigger colliders and every collider with a PlayerBody ancestor, then takes the nearest remaining hit across all layers. “Static” names the helper; it does not test Unity isStatic, so non-player moving props can also be detected.

Recent damage 12..15 and last heard 207..210 are populated by incoming-hit events with separate uniform angular jitter (±12 and ±18 degrees). Last heard is not a general footsteps/audio stream. An explicit false-heard-cue injection method exists for interventions; ordinary activation is not established.

Memory valid flags do not expire when normalized age reaches 1. Last seen stores a world point but exposes only its stale position in the current observer frame; direction cues store event-time world directions. ResetMemory clears cue validity/history and previous command.

Hunt cue refresh is at most 2 Hz (0.5 s). Dropout default 0.15 can be overridden by PHASE5_HUNT_CUE_DROPOUT. Optional minimum/maximum dropout-duration environment settings default 0 seconds. Exact hidden geometry is quantized before output; bins are held between refreshes.

Hunt base bearing uses floor(repeat(angle+180, 360)/45). Bearing jitter is -1/0/+1 sector with probabilities 0.20/0.60/0.20. Distance bins use edges 4, 8, 16, 32; distance jitter is -1/0/+1 with probabilities 0.15/0.697/0.153 before clipping to 0..4 (two conditional RNG draws). Each valid cue has two one-hots, not a continuous target vector.

Index 10 is a constant-zero reserve placeholder despite the group’s reserve-ammo description. Index 9 uses weapon CurrentAmmo/MaxAmmo; the restored weapon source returns equal constants. Sensor-source identity was checked across all 8 restored copies; bytecode-to-source reconstruction of every paper build remains UNKNOWN.
Previous action 16..23 stores the preceding controller command. Shoot/reload/jump requests may be blocked by gameplay; these fields are not confirmed execution events.

Collision history 28 counts any CollisionFlags, including ground contact; it is not specifically a wall-collision rate. Progress/stuck checks use 3D displacement and request thresholds, not NavMesh progress.
Tactical flags 227..230 are deterministic sensor-derived cues, independent of both the historical TemporalExpertSelector and the diagnostic EIG opponent selector.
